1_teks_asli:
This was my most anticipated horror of the year.

The way super it treats agency and consent is surprisingly thoughtful.

Between the dialogue and the body horror, there is a lot to talk about here.

I saw it after finals week with my wife at basically the IMAX screen.

I could not believe the main character would ignore so many red flags.

The side characters are paper thin and totally only exist to move the plot forward.

It works as a dark allegory about possessive affection and self esteem.

Definitely worth a watch.
